patch_description: Building on the best-performing seed (RY+RZ pre-rotation, fixed CZ chain, RZ post-rotation; 146 params, 0.85 score), I keep the low-parameter fixed-entangler philosophy but improve connectivity and rotation-axis diversity. Key changes: (1) replace the open CZ chain with a fixed CNOT ring (wraparound 0->1->...->7->0) for full-cycle connectivity without adding parameters, since CNOT mixes amplitudes more strongly than CZ (phase-only) and the ring closes the loop missing in the seed's open chain; (2) use RX for the post-entangling layer instead of RZ, since the feature map (IsingZZ) and any Z-axis rotations already saturate Z-basis information — an X-axis rotation gives a genuinely different, less redundant basis for readout, especially since measurement is PauliZ (RX before measurement changes which Z-eigenstate populations you read out, increasing effective expressivity per parameter); (3) keep RY+RZ pre-rotation as before for full local expressivity before entangling. This keeps params_per_block at 24 (same count as best seed: 8 RY + 8 RZ + 8 RX, zero entangler params), same total N_PARAMS=146, but with richer connectivity (ring vs chain) and better use of measurement basis, aiming to raise test accuracy and reduce generalization gap further.
